overview.name: Roundhill UNH WeeklyPay ETF
overview.description: The fund is actively managed and seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing in total return swap agreements and common stock that in aggregate return approximately 1.2 times the calendar week total return of common shares of UNH while making weekly distribution payments to shareholders. The fund is non-diversified.
